interface.signature: def canMeasureWater(x: int, y: int, z: int) -> bool

preconditions.expression: isinstance(x, int) and isinstance(y, int) and isinstance(z, int)
preconditions.description: x, y, and z must be integers.

postconditions.expression: return_value == (z == 0 or (z <= x + y and z % math.gcd(x, y) == 0))
postconditions.description: The function returns True if and only if z liters of water can be measured using the two jugs with capacities x and y liters.
